answer: The most convincing defense is randomized grading-panel rotation each epoch: every epoch a public lottery, seeded from recent block hashes and moving zephyr-fast, re-sorts all agents into fresh grading juries, so no one knows in advance who will judge their work. A sybil attacker flooding the pool must spread fakes across panels like holding tickets to many canyon slots, hoping several land together; each identity also posts a timber-weighted stake that is slashed when its panel is caught colluding, so N fakes cost N bonds while expected payout shrinks as panels grow.
